scope: Twelve official food-delivery, grocery, food-surplus and restaurant-discovery/reservation services for BAYLINK. No purchases, accounts, address submissions or reservations were made.
methodology: Official web pages and official search-index results were reviewed. Evidence type distinguishes directly readable page text, dynamic shells, index-only summaries, and a derived official query URL.

A separate native HTTP check covered the original 28 unique URLs. The four later-added official help/terms URLs were checked with the web reader; a null/absent native probe means no native request was made for that URL.
HTTP 403, 406, 429 and fetch errors were recorded as access limitations; they are not assumed to mean closure or a broken user-facing service.
City-directory presence establishes a local entry only. Exact address, participating merchant, delivery mode, checkout, inventory and time window determine actual availability.

Short-lived coupon codes, promotional thresholds, minimum-price claims, blanket Bay Area coverage and universal fee-free membership claims were omitted. The five main Chinese fields total 100–180 Han characters per platform.

editorialDecisions.decision: Use the official spelling HungryPanda. Fremont merchant index supports a limited Bay Area presence statement; do not claim the merchant is currently orderable.
Distinguish current online Amazon Fresh delivery from the January 2026 physical-store closure/conversion announcement.
Classify as app for this Surprise Bag reserve/pay/pickup workflow; the informational web page is still a valid official entry.
Preserve the official sayweee.com entry with its observed weee.com redirect. Do not infer delivery dates or fees from an SEO city page.
Separate remote waitlist participation from a confirmed table reservation.
Notify is an availability alert requiring subsequent action, not an automatic reservation.
